pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, medium-sized tawny regions with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries due to significant image blur. The geometry of individual regions is non-uniform with complex, leaf-like edge contours.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored negative space. Pathways exhibit moderate pixel thickness and form clearly defined junction nodes where three or more paths intersect across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the dorsal line of the neck, appearing as a dark textured fringe against the sky background.
